The Pine Siskin's atit-a-tit call punctuates their flapping flight, creating a rhythmic sound that brings their flock together.
Hear the soft, low twittering of female Pine Siskins soliciting attention, a gentle call that carries through the trees to attract males.
Flocks of Pine Siskins are alive with husky, wheezy contact calls, especially while feeding, making their presence known with a lively atmosphere.
